attempts.summary: Deployed a rootless podman container (nginx:alpine) as the unprivileged Alpine user "appsvc" on node1, exposed on port 8080, wired to start at boot via an OpenRC service (appsvc-webapp) added to the default runlevel — with no active login session required for the account. Verified the setup survives a full node reboot (boot_id changed, container auto-started, HTTP 200 served, `who` shows no session for appsvc), completing the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol.
